newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Morgan Stanley ups paper stocks.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Morgan Stanley ups paper stocks.

text.p: -- Morgan Stanley said analyst Matt Berler raised the ratings on a group of paper/timber stocks to outperform from neutral.
-- Stocks include Weyerhaeuser Co, International Paper Co, Union Camp Corp, Temple-Inland Inc, Georgia-Pacific Corp and Boise Cascade Corp.
-- Analyst not immediately available for comment.

-- Georgia-Pacific gained 1-5/8 to 77-5/8, International Paper rose 5/8 to 42-1/8, Weyerhaeuser was up one to 46-3/8, Union Camp added 1-1/4 to 48-1/2, Temple-Inland added 1-1/2 to 54-1/2, and Boise Cascade rose 1-1/4 to 32-3/8.
